faq.support: Didn't find what you're looking for? Contact our

q1.question: How does 100% offline mode work?
q1.answer: LeanERP stores all data locally on your computer. You can sell, print receipts, and manage inventory without internet. When connection returns, we automatically sync with cloud backup.

q2.question: My computer is old. Will it run?
q2.answer: Yes. We've tested LeanERP on Windows XP machines, 2GB RAM, and processors from 2008. If it turns on, LeanERP runs.

q3.question: Can I migrate data from my current system?
q3.answer: Yes, we offer free assisted migration. Our team imports your products, customers, and sales history without you losing a single day of operation.

q4.question: What if I need more modules later?
q4.answer: You add modules whenever you want, without changing plans. Pay only for what you use, when you need it.

q5.question: Is data secure offline?
q5.answer: Yes. We use AES-256 encryption on the local database. Automatic backups are sent to the cloud when connection is available.

q6.question: How long does it take to start using?
q6.answer: Installation in 5 minutes. Basic product setup in 30 minutes. You're operational the same day.
